pipeline.description: Weekly social calendar planning — performance review, format allocation, and slot scheduling

parent.title: [{{date}}] Weekly social plan
description: Plan the coming week's social media calendar.
Analyze last week's performance, set themes, allocate formats across slots.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Weekly social performance review
description: ### Step 3 — Check agent memory for long-term insights
Read your `memory/project_social_strategy.md` for accumulated learnings from previous weeks/months. Factor these into this week's allocation.
- Posts published last week: N (list slugs + platforms + formats)
- Top performing post: slug, platform, impressions, clicks, reactions
- Format distribution last week vs target allocation
### Step 5 — Set format allocation for coming week
Based on performance data, allocate formats for next week's 5 slots:
- If a format performs 2x+ better than average, increase its share
If you discovered a new pattern (e.g. a format consistently outperforms), update your `memory/project_social_strategy.md` with the insight. This persists across heartbeats and informs future weeks.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Weekly social content calendar
description: ## Build this week's social content calendar
### Step 1 — Reset strategy calendar for new week
List articles by department and recency:
Assign articles and formats to each slot. Post a table comment:
| Day | Platform | Slot | Article | Post Format | Source |
- Mon/Wed slots are typically filled by daily-social (new articles published that morning)
- Tue/Thu/Fri slots can be pre-assigned to specific evergreen articles for weekly-recycle
- Apply format allocation from the performance review task
- Mark source: `daily-social` (will be filled by new articles) or `weekly-recycle` (pre-assigned evergreen)
### Step 5 — Save calendar to strategy file
Set `slug: null` for daily-social slots (filled later), set actual slugs for pre-assigned recycle slots.
2. @mention **@Content Manager** with the weekly plan for reference
